title: Easy Smoky Tunisian Tomato Grill
description: A quick and easy Tunisian dish featuring smoky diced tomatoes, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this plant-based friendly recipe is made with a raclette grill and is ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Place the tomato mixture on the raclette grill and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the tomatoes are cooking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Brush the melted butter onto the tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the tomatoes from the grill and stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Serve the smoky Tunisian tomatoes hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
